image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a maypole celebration. The central feature is a tall pole (partially obscured) with numerous colorful ribbons (red, green, yellow, blue) extending from the top downwards. A crowd of people, including children and adults, are gathered at the base, holding the ends of the ribbons. In the background, there is a building with scaffolding on the left and a white structure on the right. The lighting suggests an outdoor daytime setting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The ribbons in the upper left appear to merge into the scaffolding of the background building in a physically implausible way. Some ribbons seem to originate from or pass through the metal bars of the scaffolding rather than solely from the central pole.

The connection points between the hands of the people and the ribbons are blurry and indistinct. In several cases, the ribbon appears to melt into the hand or sleeve without a clear grip mechanism, typical of AI generation struggles with fine object interaction.
The scaffolding grid on the left building shows slight perspective inconsistencies and warping, with some vertical lines bending unnaturally.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a maypole event despite the heavy occlusion of the pole itself.
To verify if the ribbons are topologically separate from the background scaffolding or if they are incorrectly fused/melted together.
To check for anatomical correctness in the hands and arms holding the ribbons, as this is a high-risk area for AI artifacts.
To ensure the ribbons have consistent depth relative to the pole and the background buildings, checking for spatial grounding errors.

focus_areas: Ribbon attachment points at the top (occluded but implied)
Interaction between hands and ribbons (grip clarity)
Separation of ribbons from background scaffolding
